verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים יִ֠הְיֶה הַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֤ה נָכוֹן֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֥א ה֖וּא מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ עָלָ֖יו עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm yih·yeh har bêṯ- Yah·weh nā·ḵō·wn bə·rōš he·hā·rîm wə·niś·śā hū mig·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ wə·nā·hă·rū ‘ā·lāw ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains it will be raised above the hills and the peoples will stream to it
verses.literalPt: MAS nos últimos dias acontecerá que o monte da casa do SENHOR será estabelecido no cume dos montes, e se elevará sobre os outeiros, e a ele afluirão os povos.

verses.original: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־ הַר־ יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶל־ בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·lə·ḵū gō·w·yim rab·bîm wə·’ā·mə·rū lə·ḵū wə·na·‘ă·leh ’el- har- Yah·weh wə·’el- bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yō·w·rê·nū mid·də·rā·ḵāw wə·nê·lə·ḵāh bə·’ō·rə·ḥō·ṯāw kî miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn tê·ṣê ṯō·w·rāh ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And many nations will come and say Come let us go up to the mountain of the LORD to the house of the God of Jacob He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E irão muitas nações, e dirão: Vinde, e subamos ao monte do SENHOR, e à casa do Deus de Jacó, para que nos ensine os seus caminhos, e andemos pelas suas veredas; porque de Sião sairá a lei, e de Jerusalém a palavra do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְשָׁפַ֗ט בֵּ֚ין עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֛יחַ לְגוֹיִ֥ם עֲצֻמִ֖ים עַד־ רָח֑וֹק וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹֽא־ יִשְׂא֞וּ גּ֤וֹי אֶל־ גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־ יִלְמְד֥וּן ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄aṭ bên ‘am·mîm rab·bîm wə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·ḡō·w·yim ‘ă·ṣu·mîm ‘aḏ- rā·ḥō·wq wə·ḵit·tə·ṯū ḥar·ḇō·ṯê·hem lə·’it·tîm wa·ḥă·nî·ṯō·ṯê·hem lə·maz·mê·rō·wṯ lō- yiś·’ū gō·w ’el- gō·w ḥe·reḇ wə·lō- yil·mə·ḏūn ‘ō·wḏ mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Then He will judge between many peoples and arbitrate for strong . . . nations far and wide Then they will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation nor will they train anymore for war
verses.literalPt: E julgará entre muitos povos, e castigará nações poderosas e longínquas, e converterão as suas espadas em pás, e as suas lanças em foices; uma nação não levantará a espada contra outra nação, nem aprenderão mais a guerra.

verses.original: וְיָשְׁב֗וּ אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֧חַת גַּפְנ֛וֹ וְתַ֥חַת תְּאֵנָת֖וֹ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד כִּי־ פִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šə·ḇū ’îš ta·ḥaṯ gap̄·nōw wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ tə·’ê·nā·ṯōw wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ kî- p̄î Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ dib·bêr
verses.literal: And each man will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree with no one to frighten him For the mouth of the LORD of Hosts has spoken
verses.literalPt: Mas assentar-se-á cada um debaixo da sua videira, e debaixo da sua figueira, e não haverá quem os espante, porque a boca do SENHOR dos Exércitos o disse.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים יֵלְכ֕וּ אִ֖ישׁ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ נֵלֵ֛ךְ בְּשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- hā·‘am·mîm yê·lə·ḵū ’îš bə·šêm ’ĕ·lō·hāw wa·’ă·naḥ·nū nê·lêḵ bə·šêm- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: Though all . . . the nations may walk in the name of their gods yet we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Porque todos os povos andam, cada um em nome do seu deus; mas nós andaremos em nome do SENHOR nosso Deus, para todo o sempre.

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה אֹֽסְפָה֙ הַצֹּ֣לֵעָ֔ה וְהַנִּדָּחָ֖ה אֲקַבֵּ֑צָה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲרֵעֹֽתִי׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um- Yah·weh ’ō·sə·p̄āh haṣ·ṣō·lê·‘āh wə·han·nid·dā·ḥāh ’ă·qab·bê·ṣāh wa·’ă·šer hă·rê·‘ō·ṯî
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD I will gather the lame I will assemble the outcast even those whom I have afflicted
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, diz o SENHOR, congregarei a que coxeava, e recolherei a que tinha sido expulsa, e a que eu tinha maltratado.

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶת־ הַצֹּֽלֵעָה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֔ית וְהַנַּהֲלָאָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם וּמָלַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣō·lê·‘āh liš·’ê·rîṯ wə·han·na·hă·lā·’āh lə·ḡō·w ‘ā·ṣūm ū·mā·laḵ Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem bə·har ṣî·yō·wn mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: And I will make the lame into a remnant the outcast into a strong nation Then the LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever . . .
verses.literalPt: E da que coxeava farei um remanescente, e da que tinha sido arrojada para longe, uma nação poderosa; e o SENHOR reinará sobre eles no monte Sião, desde agora e para sempre.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה מִגְדַּל־ עֵ֗דֶר עֹ֛פֶל בַּת־ צִיּ֖וֹן עָדֶ֣יךָ תֵּאתֶ֑ה וּבָאָ֗ה הַמֶּמְשָׁלָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה מַמְלֶ֖כֶת לְבַ֥ת־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh miḡ·dal- ‘ê·ḏer ‘ō·p̄el baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn ‘ā·ḏe·ḵā tê·ṯeh ū·ḇā·’āh ham·mem·šā·lāh hā·ri·šō·nāh mam·le·ḵeṯ lə·ḇaṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And you O watchtower of the flock O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion the former dominion will be restored to you sovereignty will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E a ti, ó torre do rebanho, fortaleza da filha de Sião, a ti virá; sim, a ti virá o primeiro domínio, o reino da filha de Jerusalém.

verses.original: עַתָּ֕ה לָ֥מָּה תָרִ֖יעִי רֵ֑עַ הֲמֶ֣לֶךְ אֵֽין־ בָּ֗ךְ אִֽם־ יוֹעֲצֵךְ֙ אָבָ֔ד כִּֽי־ הֶחֱזִיקֵ֥ךְ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh lām·māh ṯā·rî·‘î rê·a‘ hă·me·leḵ ’ên- bāḵ ’im- yō·w·‘ă·ṣêḵ ’ā·ḇāḏ kî- he·ḥĕ·zî·qêḵ ḥîl kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Why do you now cry aloud Is there no king among you Has your counselor perished so that anguish grips you like a woman in labor
verses.literalPt: E agora, por que fazes tão grande pranto? Não há em ti rei? Pereceu o teu conselheiro? Apoderou-se de ti a dor, como da que está de parto?

verses.original: ח֧וּלִי וָגֹ֛חִי בַּת־ צִיּ֖וֹן כַּיּֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה כִּֽי־ עַתָּה֩ תֵצְאִ֨י מִקִּרְיָ֜ה וְשָׁכַ֣נְתְּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה וּבָ֤את עַד־ בָּבֶל֙ שָׁ֣ם תִּנָּצֵ֔לִי שָׁ֚ם יִגְאָלֵ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִכַּ֖ף אֹיְבָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥū·lî wā·ḡō·ḥî baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh kî- ‘at·tāh ṯê·ṣə·’î miq·qir·yāh wə·šā·ḵant baś·śā·ḏeh ū·ḇāṯ ‘aḏ- bā·ḇel šām tin·nā·ṣê·lî šām yiḡ·’ā·lêḵ Yah·weh mik·kap̄ ’ō·yə·ḇā·yiḵ
verses.literal: Writhe in agony O Daughter of Zion like a woman in labor For now you will leave the city and camp in the open fields You will go to Babylon there you will be rescued there the LORD will redeem you from the hand of your enemies
verses.literalPt: Sofre dores, e trabalha, para dar à luz, ó filha de Sião, como a que está de parto, porque agora sairás da cidade, e morarás no campo, e virás até Babilônia; ali, porém, serás livrada; ali te remirá o SENHOR da mão de teus inimigos.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים הָאֹמְרִ֣ים תֶּחֱנָ֔ף וְתַ֥חַז בְּצִיּ֖וֹן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ne·’es·p̄ū ‘ā·la·yiḵ gō·w·yim rab·bîm hā·’ō·mə·rîm te·ḥĕ·nāp̄ wə·ṯa·ḥaz bə·ṣî·yō·wn ‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: But now many nations have assembled against you saying Let her be defiled and let us feast our eyes on Zion
verses.literalPt: Agora se congregaram muitas nações contra ti, que dizem: Seja profanada, e vejam os nossos olhos o seu desejo sobre Sião.

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הֵבִ֖ינוּ עֲצָת֑וֹ כִּ֥י קִבְּצָ֖ם כֶּעָמִ֥יר גֹּֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh lō yā·ḏə·‘ū maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ Yah·weh wə·lō hê·ḇî·nū ‘ă·ṣā·ṯōw kî qib·bə·ṣām ke·‘ā·mîr gō·rə·nāh
verses.literal: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD or understand His plan for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor
verses.literalPt: Mas não sabem os pensamentos do SENHOR, nem entendem o seu conselho; porque as ajuntou como gavelas numa eira.

verses.original: ק֧וּמִי וָד֣וֹשִׁי בַת־ צִיּ֗וֹן כִּֽי־ קַרְנֵ֞ךְ אָשִׂ֤ים בַּרְזֶל֙ וּפַרְסֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ אָשִׂ֣ים נְחוּשָׁ֔ה וַהֲדִקּ֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְהַחֲרַמְתִּ֤י לַֽיהוָה֙ בִּצְעָ֔ם וְחֵילָ֖ם לַאֲד֥וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: qū·mî wā·ḏō·wō·šî ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kî- qar·nêḵ ’ā·śîm bar·zel ū·p̄ar·sō·ṯa·yiḵ ’ā·śîm nə·ḥū·šāh wa·hă·ḏiq·qō·wṯ ‘am·mîm rab·bîm wə·ha·ḥă·ram·tî Yah·weh biṣ·‘ām wə·ḥê·lām la·’ă·ḏō·wn kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Rise and thresh O Daughter of Zion for I will give you horns of iron and hooves . . . of bronze to break to pieces many peoples Then you will devote their gain to the LORD their wealth to the Lord of all the earth
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te e trilha, ó filha de Sião; porque eu farei de ferro o teu chifre, e de bronze as tuas unhas; e esmiuçarás a muitos povos, e o seu ganho será consagrado ao SENHOR, e os seus bens ao Senhor de toda a terra.
